defect: The greedy DOTALL pattern \{.*\} matches from the first { to the last } of the whole span, so two separate amendment notes and all the legal text between them become one match: _clean (line 150) deletes that text and _markers (line 145) stores it as provenance.
consequence: Every article, section, annex or preamble whose span holds two or more {…} notes with live text between them is written to units with that text silently cut out, and chunk.py copies units.text into the served chunks (its text_drift check compares chunk with unit, so nothing trips): the RAG retrieves and cites an incomplete article or section under a valid citation, and where the text sits in unnumbered paragraphs it survives in no unit at all; inline_markers carries legal text as provenance, and diff_editions reports note-only churn as a change while missing a real amendment at article level. The parser tests stay green, so nothing flags it.
proof: Run from the tree root with the venv python (dotenv stubbed so no .env is read), the tree regex (NEW) against the pre-change \{[^{}]*\} (OLD), on fixtures in the Rada TXT layout. (1) Стаття 4 with parts 1-3, a note after part 1 and one after part 3: NEW ст.4 text = «Строк дії відстрочки / 1. Відстрочка надається на строк до шести місяців.», parts 2 and 3 gone, and its single marker = «{Частина перша статті 4 … від 11.04.2024} 2. Відстрочка припиняється у разі зникнення підстави. 3. Рішення про відстрочку може бути оскаржене до суду. {Статтю 4 доповнено … від 01.10.2024}»; OLD keeps all three parts and two markers. (2) Розділ XIII ПРИКІНЦЕВІ ТА ПЕРЕХІДНІ ПОЛОЖЕННЯ, points 1-3 with notes after 1 and 2: the moratorium «до 1 січня 2028 року зупиняється вчинення виконавчих дій» is in the розд.XIII text under OLD (True) and absent under NEW (False). (3) Стаття 17 written in unnumbered paragraphs with two notes: units whose text contains «протягом 60 днів» = [ст.17] under OLD, [] under NEW. (4) diff_pair: an edition that only adds a note gives changed [] under OLD, [ст.4] under NEW; rewording part 2 between two notes gives [ст.4, ст.4/п.2] under OLD, [ст.4/п.2] under NEW. (5) The stated intent: a lone nested «{Абзац другий {в редакції Закону № 1} виключено}» is stripped whole by NEW (OLD leaves «{Абзац другий  виключено}»), so the change helps only when a span holds a single note. (6) -m unittest test_parse_structure_t9 test_article_num on the changed tree: Ran 72 tests, OK; no test feeds a {…} note to parse_edition, _clean or _markers. Not measured: how many corpus units are hit, since the tree carries no edition TXT (tests/fixtures/rada_r_sample.txt is a feed sample with 0 braces).
